ADVANCED GOLF PROGRAM
4 WORKOUTS
45-60 MINUTES EACH
MOBILITY + STRENGTH + POWER + CONTROL

TAKE YOUR GAME FURTHER:
- Higher swing speed
- More efficient power transfer
- Greater mobility and resilience
- Improved consistency
- Reduced injury risk

WORKOUT A FOCUS:
- Explosive lower-body power
- Hip drive and ground force production
- Rotational power and coordination
- Build strength into a dynamic movement pattern

WORKOUT B FOCUS:
- Single-leg strength and stability
- Anti-rotation core control
- Glute and hip engagement
- Posture and balance under load

WORKOUT C FOCUS:
- Upper body strength and power
- Rotational strength and control
- Lat activation and shoulder stability
- Build a strong, connected swing chain

WORKOUT D FOCUS:
- Full-body power and coordination
- Rotational speed development
- Dynamic movement patterns
- Translate strength into a faster, more efficient swing
